task.question: Is 022D8E10..022D8F10 one object or several, and what is the group at +0x98..+0xA8? OPUS can declare the ABI either way but will not name fields on a guess.
task.known_evidence: Found by the sweep for writable static state as the cluster adjacent to the EE/VU0 register bank, which OPUS declared this round as EeVu0RegisterBank at 022D8F10. 33 cells, 49 bodies, 54 writes, 102 reads. IT LOOKS HETEROGENEOUS, WHICH IS WHY NOTHING WAS DECLARED: +0x00..+0x20 is written by 00369860/00369D30 (a 0xFF constant and a pointer); +0x20..+0x38 by 0036D260; +0x40..+0x98 is SSE stores from 0036D2F0 (movaps, movups, movsd) with the shape of a matrix or vector staging area; and +0x98..+0xA8 is a small group READ far more than written - +0x9C read 26 times, +0xA4 read 25 - by 00244200, which is called from exactly one place. THE HINT, AND IT IS ONLY A HINT: 00244200 loads +0x98 and multiplies it by +0xA4, shifts both results right by 6, and works beside the immediates 0x1C0 (448) and 0x1C0+0x40 (512); 0036D2A3 writes 0x200 (512) to +0xA0. 512 x 448 is the PS2 display geometry, and this store already carries LegacyPs2GsTextureContext, so a GS/display reading is plausible - but a plausible reading is not a measurement and OPUS is not making it.
task.missing_information: whether the four sub-regions belong together; what 00244200 computes; whether the 512/448 reading survives contact with the callers
task.why_it_matters: these are 256 bytes of live static state - 102 reads - with no type row at all, and the accepted types-MET criterion says contract-named state cannot sit outside the store. OPUS can supply the ABI row immediately once the population question is answered.
